description.value: The Shameful Tiki Room is a dimly lit, immersive vintage tiki bar on Vancouver's Main Street corridor, serving expertly crafted classic exotic cocktails like the Zombie, Jet Pilot, and Mai Tai alongside share plates. The decor is sourced from around the world — tapa cloth from Tonga and Fiji, custom California-carved tikis, and puffer fish lamps — evoking a genuine mid-century escape. Live surf bands and ukulele players appear regularly, and the venue welcomes all ages.
